title: Tutorial / how-to / recipe / step-by-step operation
summary: Result first, then the steps in order, each one a beat with its number on screen, long waits compressed and labelled, the finished result again at the end. Clarity beats energy: hold each step long enough to be copied.
signals: hands doing a task from one fixed angle (top-down or front)

runtime.why: Each step needs time to be followed; trim waiting, not steps.

hook.purpose: the finished result, then the promise ("3 steps", "5 minutes")
hook.graphics: title with the number of steps or the time

structure.purpose: one step per beat; long waits sped up and labelled
structure.graphics: step (numbered), callout, magnifier, progress for waiting

structure.purpose: the result, same framing as the hook
save it for later, or the product used
structure.graphics: title, cart if it is a TikTok Shop product

music.mood: light, steady, low under the voice

compliance: Safety steps shown (electricity, heat, chemicals, knives); no dangerous shortcuts
Quantities and times on screen match what was actually done
Products used are named honestly; paid placement disclosed
